name: History floor
description: Reads only the quest it is handed and asks no model: no intents or an experiment already running means no suggestion; otherwise a past history entry that worked is offered again with the metric it was checked by; otherwise one small experiment on the first intent, checked by the quest's first metric.
advantages: Free and deterministic, so it is the floor every model-backed arm has to beat on the same Quest cases, and it never nags a person whose experiment is running.
disadvantages: It does not judge whether what worked before still fits, and the experiment text is one fixed shape, so it cannot say which option is most likely to work.
